# Under the Fallen Tower

*The lampbats roost under the Fallen Tower, and something leads them. Talk with Lux about what lives in the flooded vault, then come back to Brindle to plan the way in. Then thin out the swarm in the Flooded Cellars: 40 lampbats, so the way in is quieter.*

## Objectives

1. Talk to [Lux](../npcs/lux_lune.md)
2. Defeat 40 [Lampbat](../monsters/lampbat.md) in [The Outworks: Flooded Cellars](../maps/outworks_deep_cellars.md)

## Rewards

- 10,330 EXP
- 3,920 mesos
- +60 standing with [Brindle](../npcs/brindle.md)
- +30 standing with Urbanograd
- Unlocks `boss.gloamwing`
